one_each.seed: Versioned immutable CoPre source revision plus exact hash; content is public-safe
one_each.orb: One visible coherent local surface; different projections can reuse same source
one_each.gauge: One proof gauge: source, hash, persisted age, handoff, receiver readproof, integration, privacy
one_each.thumb: One user-invoked no-side-effect pointer or command; never auto-acts on authority-changing channels
one_each.time: One explicit UTC reference clock, with age derivation; clock drift reported

gate_tests.name: EXACT_SOURCE
gate_tests.pass_if: Specified source retrieved and exact bytes/hash verified

gate_tests.name: SEED_GT_24H
gate_tests.pass_if: Same exact Seed hash available after more than 24 elapsed hours via independently read source or durable receiver

gate_tests.name: HANDOFF_ONCE
gate_tests.pass_if: One complete transfer accepted by an independently identified receiver with object-specific acknowledgement, no Rick relay

gate_tests.name: SYSTEM_1_USER_0
gate_tests.pass_if: An authorized worker discovers, dedupes, acts safely and publishes receipt without human courier work

gate_tests.name: SYNC_SELF
gate_tests.pass_if: After a controlled source revision, an authorized receiver detects it, qualifies it and updates within stated SLA without manual paste

gate_tests.name: NO_EXTRA_DRAG
gate_tests.pass_if: Measured reduction of human relays, duplicated work and attention cost versus baseline

gate_tests.name: WAVE_DIVERSITY
gate_tests.pass_if: Independent strategies produce meaningfully different useful hypotheses while retaining stable proof identity; duplicate chatter not rewarded

break_glass: Unknown authorization, unverified mirror or missing exact source: HOLD
Privacy or public-release uncertainty: HOLD private, propose public-safe derivative
Conflicting same identity: branch for review, never overwrite
Repeated echo without measurable improvement: QUIESCE and preserve alternatives
No independent receiver readproof: do not claim PICKED_UP or INTEGRATED
source_bound_all_fronts: Any authorized front may retrieve source, report evidence, propose a candidate better and receive a machine-readable response. No automatic cross-provider pickup, authority, memory, or live runtime inferred.
creative_variation: No two waves need identical presentation or hypotheses; do not enforce artificial difference at the expense of truth, reproducibility or usability.
philosophy: G_dSide remains optional symbolic, ethical and imaginative exploration, not technical proof or authority.
next_evidence: Bounded visible browser canary with exact source hash, persistent receipt, explicit export and controlled 24-hour check.
